name: node-api
description: A self-operated Node.js API server — Express or NestJS + PostgreSQL + Prisma/Drizzle. Shares a language with the frontend.

notes.securityBoundary: The application layer is the only boundary — the DB is reached over a trusted connection, so nothing leans on row-level policy. A missing ownership check is a data leak. The authentication method (self-issued JWT · session · external IdP) is undecided, so it is a question to confirm
notes.serverCodeLocation: The API server in this repository. Even when the frontend axis has a server runtime (Next.js, etc.), API ownership sits here — the guide pins the boundary of which of the two holds the logic first
notes.toolchain: The language and package manager are often the same as the frontend's, so monorepos are common — the guide covers whether to add shared type and schema packages
notes.variants: The choice of framework (Express/NestJS) and ORM (Prisma/Drizzle) heavily splits the guide content — it is fixed at Step 4.5
